findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#beat-0" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.

In timeline "reel-main", a tween on rotateX of #botHead ends at 10.920 s, 0.040 s after a later tween on rotateX ends at 10.880 s. For that tail the earlier tween takes rotateX back and leaves its own end value on screen, so the later tween's end never shows. End the earlier tween by 10.680 s, or add overwrite: "auto" to the later tween.
